definition: I. [ עָקַד ] verb bind (Late Hebrew id., bind bent limbs together ; Arabic tie, tie fast ; Ethiopic Syriac and especially bend, twist ; ᵑ7 עֲקַד as Late Hebrew; also kneel , compare Christian Palestinian Aramaic, Schw Idioticon 71 ); — Qal Imperfect וַיַּעֲקֹד אֶתיִֿצְחָק Gen 22:9 .
